import os

md_paths = [p for p in dir_resp if p.lower().endswith('.md')]
print('md_files_count', len(md_paths))

created = []
for p in md_paths:
    filename = os.path.basename(p)
    stem, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    title = stem.replace('_', ' ')
    file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_info['content']
    resp = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    created.append({'path': p, 'title': title, 'note_id': resp.get('note_id'), 'message': resp.get('message')})

print('created_count', len(created))
print('first_created', created[0])
print('last_created', created[-1])

# Verification using the already-created notes from the prior execution
assert 'created' in globals(), 'created variable missing'
assert 'md_paths' in globals(), 'md_paths variable missing'

missing_note_ids = [c for c in created if not c.get('note_id')]
print('md_files_count', len(md_paths))
print('created_count', len(created))
print('missing_note_ids_count', len(missing_note_ids))
if missing_note_ids:
    print('missing_example', missing_note_ids[0])

# Also verify title transformation rule and one sample
import os

def expected_title(path):
    stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0]
    return stem.replace('_',' ')

bad_titles=[]
for c in created:
    exp=expected_title(c['path'])
    if c['title']!=exp:
        bad_titles.append({'path':c['path'],'expected':exp,'actual':c['title']})
print('bad_titles_count', len(bad_titles))
if bad_titles:
    print('bad_title_example', bad_titles[0])

# Complete supervisor task (no answer needed for action task)
res = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print(res)
